front: Why is tobacco so hard to give up?
back: Its nicotine is a highly addictive stimulant.

front: Two drugs of current concern in Zimbabwe
back: Codeine cough syrups (an opioid depressant) and crystal methamphetamine (a highly addictive stimulant).

front: Where can someone dependent on a drug get help?
back: From a trusted adult, teacher or school counsellor, a clinic or health worker, or rehabilitation services.
